name: beredskapsboka
description: Offline-first Norwegian Civil Defence field-support PWA with local missions, checklists, map/log workflow and privacy-safe exports.

scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:sw && npm run build:app
scripts.start: mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && rm -rf .next/standalone/public .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -R public .next/standalone/public && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cd .next/standalone && node server.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:prod:no-build
scripts.e2e:prod: npm run build && npm run e2e:prod:no-build
scripts.map:fetch: gh release download map-packages-20260610 --pattern '*.pmtiles' --dir public/map-packages --clobber && shasum -a 256 -c scripts/map-packages.sha256
scripts.build:content: npm run import:obsidian && npm run compile:curated && npm run build:search && npm run sync:workplans && npm run validate:content
scripts.check:generated: git diff --cached --exit-code -- content/generated/source-documents.json content/generated/source-snapshot-metadata.json content/workplans/workplans.json && git diff --exit-code -- content/generated/source-documents.json content/generated/source-snapshot-metadata.json content/workplans/workplans.json
scripts.check:ci: npm run audit:ci && npm run check:workplans && npm run build:content && npm run check:generated && npm run build:sw && npm run check:sw && npm run validate:maps && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:app && npm run e2e:prod:no-build && npm run perf:budget && npm run perf:lighthouse
scripts.build:vinext: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const name of ['trondheim-osm', 'trondelag-osm']) fs.rmSync('dist/client/map-packages/' + name + '.pmtiles', { force: true }); for (const name of ['maplibre-gl-worker.mjs', 'maplibre-gl-shared.mjs']) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/' + name, 'dist/client/_next/static/chunks/' + name)" && next typegen
scripts.deploy:vinext: npm run build:vinext && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
